message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Wheel Builder

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - '*'

jobs:
  build_wheels:
    name: Push new release to PyPI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: pypi
      url: https://pypi.org/p/mpf
    permissions:
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout MPF
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: 3.13

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install MPF
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y '^libxcb.*-dev' libx11-xcb-dev libjpeg-dev
          sudo apt-get install -y qt6-base-dev
          pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel build
          pip install -e .

      - name: Run tests
        run: python -m unittest discover -s mpf/tests

      - name: Build wheel
        run: python -m build

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          path: ./dist/*.*

      - name: Publish to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1",
  "rationale": "The workflow currently downloads Python dependencies on every run without caching. Experimental evidence (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) shows adding a pip cache step to a similar Python workflow yielded a 9.2% elapsed time reduction. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern from literature also supports caching dependency downloads. The pyproject.toml file provides a stable, version-pinned cache key. This change preserves all build and test coverage while reducing redundant network transfers and installation time.",
  "evidence_ids": [
    "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2",
    "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-3d6f1c5a422aa116-r2",
    "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"
  ]
}
